mapper.sql: SELECT f.id, f.room_id, f.owner_id, f.fee_type, f.period, f.amount, f.status, f.due_date, f.pay_time, f.pay_method, f.create_time, r.room_no AS roomNo, b.name AS buildingName, o.name AS ownerName, o.phone AS ownerPhone FROM t_fee_bill f LEFT JOIN t_room r ON r.id = f.room_id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON b.id = r.building_id LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON o.id = f.owner_id

sql.if: AND (o.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.room_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: ORDER BY f.period DESC, f.status ASC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_fee_bill f LEFT JOIN t_room r ON r.id = f.room_id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON b.id = r.building_id LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON o.id = f.owner_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_fee_bill (room_id, owner_id, fee_type, period, amount, status, due_date, pay_time, pay_method, create_time) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{ownerId}, #{feeType}, #{period}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{dueDate}, #{payTime}, #{payMethod}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_fee_bill SET room_id = #{roomId}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, fee_type = #{feeType}, period = #{period}, amount = #{amount}, status = #{status}, due_date = #{dueDate}, pay_time = #{payTime}, pay_method = #{payMethod} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_fee_bill WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_fee_bill WHERE status = '未缴' AND owner_id = #{ownerId}
SELECT period AS period, SUM(amount) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已缴' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS paid FROM t_fee_bill GROUP BY period ORDER BY period DESC LIMIT 6
